_comment: Places that get info cards. 'wiki' = English Wikipedia title (null = no article; the card uses 'blurb'). 'zone' says where the place is in our data: landmark:<id> | osm:<type>/<id> | roads:<OSM road name> | circle:<x>,<y>,<radius m>. 'priority': higher wins when zones overlap. Blurbs marked review:true are hand-written and need a fact check.

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.blurb: The Palace of Winds, built in 1799: a five-storey screen of small latticed windows from which the royal women of the court could watch the street unseen.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.blurb: The city's congregational mosque, on Johari Bazar a short walk south of Badi Chaupar.

places.name: Badi Chaupar
places.blurb: The great square at the meeting of the walled city's main bazaars, laid out on the 1727 grid plan.

places.name: Johari Bazaar
places.blurb: Johari means jeweller: the bazaar running south from Badi Chaupar is the walled city's jewellery and gem market, lined with pink arcaded shops.

places.name: Tripolia Bazaar
places.blurb: The bazaar running west from Badi Chaupar towards Tripolia Gate, the three-arched gate to the City Palace.

places.name: Ramganj Bazaar
places.blurb: The bazaar running east from Badi Chaupar towards Suraj Pol, the Sun Gate in the eastern city wall.

discover._comment: Wikipedia geosearch inside the slice boundary adds other articles. Titles matching 'exclude' are skipped (not places, or not in the modelled area yet).
